name: fix-slide-frontmatter-syntax
body: source: 'Every slide file begins with YAML frontmatter'; inconsistency: slide frontmatter delimiter and the slide-body boundary were unspecified, and could be confused with the section plain-fence frontmatter (feedback-2); resolution: slide frontmatter is standard YAML delimited by `---` … `---` at the very top of the file; the plain ``` fence is only for section frontmatter; content between slide frontmatter and the first `#` heading is the slide body — written into slide-template-required, slide-sections, section-frontmatter and the slide-parser component [with user]
